title: Synthesis and cytotoxic evaluation of pyrido-dipyrimidine derivatives: Mechanism of action, DNA and HSA binding studies.
authors: Milovic, Lazar; Grozdanic, Nada; Stanojkovic, Tatjana; Jovanovic, Jelena Dorovic; Jeremic, Svetlana; Petrovic, Maja; Markovic, Milica; Simovic, Ana Rilak; Jankovic, Nenad
one_liner_zh: 该研究合成并评估吡啶并二嘧啶衍生物的抗癌活性，通过光谱和分子对接/动力学模拟研究其与DNA及HSA的结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作和物理模拟，但核心为药物小分子与DNA的非TF-DNA体系，且方法偏实验验证，与课题聚焦的TF-DNA结合机制建模关联较弱。
abstract: This study presents the synthesis of a novel series of pyrido[2,3-d:6,5-d']dipyrimidine derivatives (4a-v) via an 'on-water' multicomponent reaction, utilizing thiobarbituric acid, diverse aldehydes, and amines at room temperature. The compounds were evaluated for cytotoxic activity against human cancer cell lines (HeLa, K562, LS174, A549) and normal fibroblasts (MRC-5) using MTT assays. Notable potency was observed against HeLa and K562 cells, with IC(50) values ranging from 9.82 to 192.47 muM. Compound 4k exhibited the strongest activity against HeLa (IC(50) = 9.82 +/- 1.07 muM) with a selectivity index (SI) >12, while 4u was most effective against K562 (IC(50) = 17.36 +/- 1.39 muM, SI >9). LS174 and A549 showed limited sensitivity. Structure-activity relationship (SAR) analysis revealed that para-hydroxyphenyl substituents at position 5 and thiocarbonyl groups enhanced cytotoxicity, particularly against leukemia cells, via improved hydrogen bonding and target affinity. Mechanistic studies on 4k and 4u focused on DNA and human serum albumin (HSA) interactions. UV-Vis and fluorescence spectroscopy, including ethidium bromide displacement and viscosity measurements, indicated minor groove binding to CT-DNA (K(b)  approximately  10(4) M(-1); K(sv)  approximately  10(4) M(-1)) with partial intercalation. HSA binding occurred via static quenching at sites I and II (K(sv)  approximately  10(5) M(-1); K(b)  approximately 10(5) M(-1)), confirmed by competitive assays with Eosin Y and ibuprofen. Cell cycle analysis and AO/EB staining demonstrated apoptosis induction, with increased subG1 populations. Caspase assays showed 4k activated both intrinsic (caspase-9) and extrinsic (caspase-8) pathways in HeLa cells, leading to caspase-3 execution; 4u induced caspase-independent apoptosis in K562. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations supported minor groove DNA preference and HSA site I/II binding, with stable complexes (DeltaG(bind) </= -8 kcal/mol). RMSD, RMSF, and Rg analyses affirmed structural integrity. These derivatives emerge as promising selective anticancer agents targeting DNA and apoptosis, warranting further optimization and in vivo studies.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过“on-water”多组分反应，在室温下利用硫代巴比妥酸、多种醛和胺，合成了一系列新型吡啶并[2,3-d:6,5-d']二嘧啶衍生物（4a-v）。通过MTT实验评估了这些化合物对人癌细胞系（HeLa、K562、LS174、A549）和正常成纤维细胞（MRC-5）的细胞毒性活性。对HeLa和K562细胞观察到显著效力，IC(50)值范围为9.82至192.47 μM。化合物4k对HeLa表现出最强活性（IC(50) = 9.82 ± 1.07 μM），选择性指数（SI）>12，而4u对K562最有效（IC(50) = 17.36 ± 1.39 μM，SI >9）。LS174和A549显示出有限敏感性。构效关系（SAR）分析揭示，5位对羟基苯基取代基和硫代羰基通过改善氢键和靶标亲和力增强了细胞毒性，特别是对白血病细胞。针对4k和4u的机制研究聚焦于DNA和人血清白蛋白（HSA）相互作用。紫外-可见光谱和荧光光谱，包括溴化乙锭置换和粘度测量，表明与CT-DNA发生小沟结合（K(b) ≈ 10(4) M(-1)；K(sv) ≈ 10(4) M(-1)），并伴有部分嵌入。HSA结合通过位点I和II的静态猝灭发生（K(sv) ≈ 10(5) M(-1)；K(b) ≈ 10(5) M(-1)），通过伊红Y和布洛芬竞争实验确认。细胞周期分析和AO/EB染色证明诱导凋亡，subG1群体增加。Caspase实验显示，4k在HeLa细胞中激活了内源性（caspase-9）和外源性（caspase-8）通路，导致caspase-3执行；4u在K562中诱导caspase非依赖性凋亡。分子对接和动力学模拟支持小沟DNA偏好和HSA位点I/II结合，形成稳定复合物（DeltaG(bind) ≤ -8 kcal/mol）。RMSD、RMSF和Rg分析确认了结构完整性。这些衍生物作为靶向DNA和凋亡的选择性抗癌剂具有前景，值得进一步优化和体内研究。
